WITH rating_avg AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) as avg_len
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(length) as baseline_len
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
),
step1 AS (
  SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_len
  FROM rating_avg ra
  WHERE ra.avg_len > (SELECT baseline_len FROM baseline)
),
step2_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_len) as step2_mean_len
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.rating, s1.avg_len
  FROM step1 s1
  WHERE s1.avg_len > (SELECT step2_mean_len FROM step2_mean)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(s3.avg_len) as final_mean,
  AVG(s3.avg_len - (SELECT baseline_len FROM baseline)) as mean_excess_baseline,
  AVG(s3.avg_len - (SELECT step2_mean_len FROM step2_mean)) as mean_excess_mean
FROM step3 s3;
